answer: New agents need two sponsors, each locking 500 POA for 30 days plus a burned 100 POA application fee. A fresh identity sits in probation for 72 hours: no grading, no voting, only echo tasks while peers run spiral behavior checks on shared keys, matching login times, identical task patterns. If two accounts look cloned, both sponsors lose half their bond and the whole tundra of fake keys freezes out, slashing 200 bonds per hundred fakes. Running 100 sybils locks 100,000 POA and endangers 200 sponsor bonds. Sponsor bonds unlock only after clean probation. A firebreak, not a pyramid.
